title: Adding Custom Types
goal: Implement operator overloading for references to preserve ownership.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: Check the signature of add: rhs is a reference, so LHS must also be a reference trait implementation.
Using &s1 passes a reference so s1 is not moved.
explanation: Implementing `Add for &Score` allows addition between `&Score` and `&Score` without taking ownership of `s1` or `s2`. Implementing `Add for Score` with `fn add(self, rhs: &Score)` fails with `E0053` because the trait signature expects `rhs: Score`. Passing `s1` instead of `&s1` fails with `E0308` because type mismatch occurs when LHS is expected to be a reference.
